items.source: Resolves HttpEntity and RequestEntity method argument values, as well as return values of type HttpEntity, ResponseEntity, ErrorResponse and ProblemDetail.
items.translation: 解析 `HttpEntity` 和 `RequestEntity` 的方法参数值，以及类型为 `HttpEntity`、`ResponseEntity`、`ErrorResponse` 和 `ProblemDetail` 的返回值。

items.source: Handler for return values of type ResponseEntity that delegates to one of the following: HttpEntityMethodProcessor for responses with a concrete body value ResponseBodyEmitterReturnValueHandler for responses with a body that is a ResponseBodyEmitter or an async/reactive type.
items.translation: 处理返回类型为ResponseEntity的处理器，它会委托给以下处理器之一： 对于具有具体体值的响应，委托给HttpEntityMethodProcessor； 对于体为ResponseBodyEmitter或异步/响应式类型的响应，委托给ResponseBodyEmitterReturnValueHandler。

items.source: Resolves the following method arguments: Annotated with @RequestPart Of type MultipartFile in conjunction with Spring's MultipartResolver abstraction Of type jakarta.servlet.http.Part in conjunction with Servlet multipart requests
items.translation: 解决以下方法参数： 带有 `@RequestPart` 注解 类型为 `MultipartFile`，与 Spring 的 `MultipartResolver` 抽象配合使用 类型为 `jakarta.servlet.http.Part`，与 Servlet 多部分请求配合使用

items.source: Extension of AbstractHandlerMethodAdapter that supports @RequestMapping annotated HandlerMethods.
items.translation: 扩展了支持带有 `@RequestMapping` 注解的 `HandlerMethods` 的 `AbstractHandlerMethodAdapter`。

items.source: A Servlet-specific AbstractWebArgumentResolverAdapter that creates a NativeWebRequest from ServletRequestAttributes.
items.translation: 一个特定于 Servlet 的AbstractWebArgumentResolverAdapter，它从ServletRequestAttributes创建NativeWebRequest。

items.source: MVC infrastructure for annotation-based handler method processing, building on the org.springframework.web.method.annotation package. Entry points are RequestMappingHandlerMapping and RequestMappingHandlerAdapter.
items.translation: 用于基于注解的处理方法处理的 MVC 基础设施，建立在org.springframework.web.method.annotation包之上。入口点是RequestMappingHandlerMapping和RequestMappingHandlerAdapter。

items.source: A RequestBodyAdvice implementation that adds support for Jackson's @JsonView annotation declared on a Spring MVC @HttpEntity or @RequestBody method parameter.
items.translation: 一个实现了RequestBodyAdvice的类，它为在 Spring MVC 的@HttpEntity或@RequestBody方法参数上声明的 Jackson@JsonView注解提供支持。

items.source: A ResponseBodyAdvice implementation that adds support for Jackson's @JsonView annotation declared on a Spring MVC @RequestMapping or @ExceptionHandler method.
items.translation: 一个实现了 `ResponseBodyAdvice` 的类，它为在 Spring MVC 的 `@RequestMapping` 或 `@ExceptionHandler` 方法上声明的 Jackson 的 `@JsonView` 注解提供支持。

items.source: Extends InvocableHandlerMethod with the ability to handle return values through a registered HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler and also supports setting the response status based on a method-level @ResponseStatus annotation.
items.translation: 继承InvocableHandlerMethod，具备通过已注册的HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler处理返回值的能力，并且支持根据方法级别的@ResponseStatus注解设置响应状态。

items.source: Handles return values of type ModelAndView copying view and model information to the ModelAndViewContainer.
items.translation: 处理类型为 ModelAndView 的返回值，将视图和模型信息复制到 ModelAndViewContainer。

items.source: Resolves Map method arguments annotated with @PathVariable where the annotation does not specify a path variable name.
items.translation: 解决带有未指定路径变量名称的 Map 方法参数的 @PathVariable 注解。

items.source: Resolves an argument of type Principal, similar to ServletRequestMethodArgumentResolver but irrespective of whether the argument is annotated or not.
items.translation: 解析类型为 Principal 的参数，类似于 ServletRequestMethodArgumentResolver，但无论参数是否带有注解均适用。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with @RequestBody and handles return values from methods annotated with @ResponseBody by reading and writing to the body of the request or response with an HttpMessageConverter.
items.translation: 解析带有@RequestBody注解的方法参数，并通过使用HttpMessageConverter读取和写入请求或响应的主体来处理带有@ResponseBody注解的方法的返回值。

items.source: Handler for return values of type: ResponseBodyEmitter including sub-class SseEmitter and others.
items.translation: 用于返回类型为 `ResponseBodyEmitter`（包括其子类 `SseEmitter` 及其他类型）的处理器。

items.source: A Servlet-specific ModelAttributeMethodProcessor that applies data binding through a WebDataBinder of type ServletRequestDataBinder.
items.translation: 一个特定于 Servlet 的ModelAttributeMethodProcessor，它通过类型为ServletRequestDataBinder的 WebDataBinder 应用数据绑定。

items.source: An AbstractHandlerMethodExceptionResolver that resolves exceptions through @ExceptionHandler methods.
items.translation: 一个通过 `@ExceptionHandler` 方法解析异常的 `AbstractHandlerMethodExceptionResolver`。

items.source: Creates instances of UriComponentsBuilder by pointing to @RequestMapping methods on Spring MVC controllers.
items.translation: 创建指向 Spring MVC 控制器上@RequestMapping方法的UriComponentsBuilder实例。

items.source: A class with an @ExceptionHandler method that handles all Spring MVC raised exceptions by returning a ResponseEntity with RFC 9457 formatted error details in the body.
items.translation: 包含 `@ExceptionHandler` 方法的类，该方法处理所有 Spring MVC 抛出的异常，并通过返回一个在正文中包含按 RFC 9457 格式化的错误详情的 ResponseEntity 来实现。

items.source: An AbstractCookieValueMethodArgumentResolver that resolves cookie values from an HttpServletRequest.
items.translation: 一个从HttpServletRequest解析 Cookie 值的AbstractCookieValueMethodArgumentResolver。

items.source: A specialization of ResponseBodyEmitter for sending Server-Sent Events.
items.translation: 一个用于发送 服务器发送事件 的 ResponseBodyEmitter 特化类。

items.source: Supports return values of type StreamingResponseBody and also ResponseEntity<StreamingResponseBody>.
items.translation: 支持返回类型为 `StreamingResponseBody` 以及 `ResponseEntity<StreamingResponseBody>` 的值。

items.source: Subclass of ServletRequestDataBinder that adds URI template variables to the values used for data binding.
items.translation: 继承自ServletRequestDataBinder 的类，它会将 URI 模板变量添加到用于数据绑定的值中。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with an @PathVariable.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@PathVariable` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: Resolves method arguments of type RedirectAttributes.
items.translation: 解析类型为RedirectAttributes的方法参数。

items.source: A convenient starting point for implementing RequestBodyAdvice with default method implementations.
items.translation: 一个方便的起点，用于实现带有默认方法实现的 RequestBodyAdvice。

items.source: Resolvers argument values of type UriComponentsBuilder.
items.translation: 解析器参数类型为UriComponentsBuilder。

items.source: Handles return values that are of type View.
items.translation: 处理类型为View的返回值。

items.source: Creates RequestMappingInfo instances from type-level and method-level @RequestMapping and @HttpExchange annotations in @Controller classes.
items.translation: 从 `<@Controller>` 类中的类型级和方法级@RequestMapping及@HttpExchange注解创建RequestMappingInfo实例。

items.source: A convenient base class for ResponseBodyAdvice implementations that customize the response before JSON serialization with AbstractJacksonHttpMessageConverter's and AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter's concrete subclasses.
items.translation: 一个方便的基类，用于实现 ResponseBodyAdvice，以便在 JSON 序列化之前自定义响应，适用于AbstractJacksonHttpMessageConverter及其具体子类以及AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter。

items.source: Extends AbstractMessageConverterMethodArgumentResolver with the ability to handle method return values by writing to the response with HttpMessageConverters.
items.translation: 继承 `AbstractMessageConverterMethodArgumentResolver`，并具备通过 `HttpMessageConverters` 将方法返回值写入响应流的能力。

items.source: Handler for return values of type DeferredResult and CompletionStage.
items.translation: 用于处理类型为 DeferredResult 和 CompletionStage 的返回值的处理器。

items.source: A RequestBodyAdvice implementation that adds support for resolving Kotlin KType from the parameter and providing it as a hint with a "kotlin.reflect.KType" key.
items.translation: 一个实现了RequestBodyAdvice的类，用于支持从参数中解析 Kotlin KType 并将其作为带有"kotlin.reflect.KType"键的提示提供。

items.source: A ResponseBodyAdvice implementation that adds support for resolving Kotlin KType from the return type and providing it as a hint with a "kotlin.reflect.KType" key.
items.translation: 一个实现了 `ResponseBodyAdvice` 的类，用于支持从返回类型中解析 Kotlin KType，并以 `"kotlin.reflect.KType"` 作为键提供该类型作为提示。

items.source: Resolves arguments of type Map annotated with @MatrixVariable where the annotation does not specify a name.
items.translation: 解析带有未指定名称的 `Map` 类型参数的 `@MatrixVariable` 注解。

items.source: Allows customizing the response after the execution of an @ResponseBody or a ResponseEntity controller method but before the body is written with an HttpMessageConverter.
items.translation: 允许在 `@ResponseBody` 或 `ResponseEntity` 控制器方法执行后、但在使用 `HttpMessageConverter` 写入正文之前，自定义响应。

items.source: A base class for resolving method argument values by reading from the body of a request with HttpMessageConverters.
items.translation: 一个用于通过从请求主体中读取数据，利用HttpMessageConverters解析方法参数值的基类。

items.source: Resolves argument values of type SemanticApiVersionParser.Version.
items.translation: 解析类型为SemanticApiVersionParser.Version的参数值。

items.source: Handles return values of type WebAsyncTask.
items.translation: 处理类型为WebAsyncTask的返回值。

items.source: Handles return values of type Callable.
items.translation: 处理类型为Callable的返回值。

items.source: Handles HttpHeaders return values.
items.translation: 处理 `HttpHeaders` 返回值。

items.source: Resolves arguments annotated with @MatrixVariable.
items.translation: 解析带有@MatrixVariable注解的参数。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with an @RequestAttribute.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@RequestAttribute` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: Allows customizing the request before its body is read and converted into an Object and also allows for processing of the resulting Object before it is passed into a controller method as an @RequestBody or an HttpEntity method argument.
items.translation: 允许在读取请求体并将其转换为对象之前自定义请求，同时也允许在处理结果对象并将其作为 `@RequestBody` 或 `HttpEntity` 方法参数传递给控制器方法之前进行处理。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with an @SessionAttribute.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@SessionAttribute` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: Handles return values of types void and String interpreting them as view name reference.
items.translation: 处理类型为void和String的返回值，将其解释为视图名称引用。

items.source: Servlet-based infrastructure for handler method processing, building on the org.springframework.web.method package.
items.translation: 基于 Servlet 的基础设施，用于处理处理器方法，构建于 `org.springframework.web.method` 包之上。

items.source: No-op resolver for method arguments of type Continuation.
items.translation: Continuation 类型方法参数的无操作解析器。

items.source: Creates a ServletRequestDataBinder.
items.translation: 创建一个ServletRequestDataBinder。

items.source: A controller method return value type for asynchronous request processing where the application can write directly to the response OutputStream without holding up the Servlet container thread.
items.translation: 异步请求处理中控制器方法的返回值类型，应用程序可借此直接写入响应 `<code>OutputStream`》，而无需占用 Servlet 容器线程。

items.source:
This return value handler is intended to be ordered after all others as it
attempts to handle _any_ return value type (i.e.
items.translation: 此返回值处理器旨在置于所有其他处理器之后，因为它尝试处理任何类型的返回值（即

items.source: Builder class to create URLs for method arguments.
items.translation: 用于创建方法参数 URL 的 Builder 类。

items.source: Method invocation information.
items.translation: 方法调用信息。

items.source:
A controller method return value type for asynchronous request processing
where one or more objects are written to the response.
items.translation: 用于异步请求处理的控制器方法返回值类型，其中将一个或多个对象写入响应。

items.source:
A simple holder of data to be written along with a MediaType hint for
selecting a message converter to write with.
items.translation: 一个用于存储待写入数据的简单容器，并附带一个 MediaType 提示，以选择用于写入的消息转换器。

items.source: Resolves servlet backed request-related method arguments.
items.translation: 解析由 Servlet 支持的相关请求方法参数。

items.source: Resolves servlet backed response-related method arguments.
items.translation: 解决由 Servlet 支持的与响应相关的方法参数。

items.source: A builder for an SSE event.
items.translation: SSE 事件的构建器。
